item.tib: gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs
item.skt: rak+ta ya mA ri sA d+ha naM
item.coloph: gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs dpal rnam par snang mdzad srung bas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun chen po nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas/ chag lo tsA ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
